fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: Ingest On Write
fields.help: Whether or not the cache ingests data as the data is written to the bucket.

fields.label: Ttl
fields.help: The TTL of all cache entries in whole seconds.

fields.label: Zone
fields.help: The zone in which the cache instance needs to be created.
